name: queue-tea
description: One task at a time per project, a priority queue, a branch per task, and a record of time and effort.

idleGapMinutes.title: Idle gap (minutes)
idleGapMinutes.description: A gap in activity longer than this stops the clock.

freshAtTokens.title: Fresh conversation at (tokens)
freshAtTokens.description: Past this conversation size, a handoff note is written and the task carries on in a fresh conversation.

handoffAtPercent.title: Handoff note at (% of the 5-hour allowance)
handoffAtPercent.description: At this share of the 5-hour allowance, a handoff note is written so nothing is lost if the limit is reached.

checkTimeoutSeconds.title: Message check time limit (seconds)
checkTimeoutSeconds.description: A message check that takes longer than this counts as not run.
